description: This file defines the CurlMultiHandler class in the GuzzleHttp library, responsible for managing asynchronous HTTP requests using curl_multi_* functions. It includes properties for managing curl handles, options, and request queueing, as well as methods for executing, ticking, adding, canceling, and processing curl handles asynchronously.

classes.name: CurlMultiHandler
classes.description: Handles asynchronous HTTP requests using curl_multi_* functions, managing multiple HTTP handles concurrently with support for delays, cancellations, and event loop integration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with optional configuration options for handle factory, select timeout, and curl options.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the curl multi handle resource, applying configured options.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the curl multi handle resource upon object destruction.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles sending an asynchronous request by creating a curl handle and returning a promise.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Performs a tick of the curl event loop, processing messages, handling delays, and integrating with the event queue.

methods.name: tickInQueue
methods.description: Runs curl_multi_exec within the event queue to prevent busy loops.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Runs the event loop until all requests are completed.

methods.name: addRequest
methods.description: Adds a new request handle entry to the handler, managing immediate or delayed addition.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels an in-progress request handle, removing it from the multi handle and closing it.

methods.name: processMessages
methods.description: Processes completed curl messages, resolving associated promises.

methods.name: timeToNext
methods.description: Calculates the time until the next delay threshold is reached.
